scenarios_meta.name: Clean Healthy Container
scenarios_meta.description: PostgreSQL with nothing but routine checkpoints and connections. Should be trivially scored healthy.

scenarios_meta.name: OOM Crash Loop
scenarios_meta.description: Extreme failure: OOM kills, crash loops, high resource usage. Should be trivially scored critical.

scenarios_meta.name: Recovered After Errors
scenarios_meta.description: Container had connection errors early but recovered. Tests recovery detection.

scenarios_meta.name: Routine Errors (Tagged Known Patterns)
scenarios_meta.description: All errors are tagged [ROUTINE]. Tests whether model trusts the tagging system.

scenarios_meta.name: Degraded Performance
scenarios_meta.description: Slow response times, some timeouts, but service still responding. Should be degraded, not unhealthy.

scenarios_meta.name: PostgreSQL Graceful Shutdown (FATAL is Normal)
scenarios_meta.description: FATAL errors during planned shutdown. Tests understanding that shutdown FATALs are expected.

scenarios_meta.name: High CPU Normal Workload (False Positive Trap)
scenarios_meta.description: CPU at 95% but logs show normal transcoding. Tests resource vs log correlation.

scenarios_meta.name: Network Dependency Failure (External, No Restart)
scenarios_meta.description: External API failures. Container itself is fine. Tests error_origin and restart_would_help logic.
